_doc: 版本標識檔。guardian＝Workflow Guardian（hooks + MCP server）版本，Dashboard 標題與 MCP serverInfo 顯示；atom_memory＝原子記憶系統版本；release_date＝此版本正式發布日；release_theme＝此版本主題一句話。程式讀者：tools/workflow-guardian-mcp/lib/paths.js（只取 guardian / atom_memory）與 tools/install.py --verify（確認本檔可讀）；文件讀者 TECH.md。
release_theme: Project-only concerns stay in the project: a root-write leak gate (warn-only by default; config section root_leak_gate, audit tool tools/root-leak-audit.py, MCP tool root_write_declare) flags project names and project paths written into the root layer, and project-specific pieces move to project-level templates (the svn test-path commit guard; the hub keys svn_test_block and verify_chains are retired; prebuild checks read the project's own .claude/prebuild-checks.json); the auto-heal tool resolves card references through Aka names the same way the health check does, so a renamed card's old name is no longer treated as a broken link; the Stop handler drops an unused import
